_README: Plugins that LEFT this repository but whose leftovers on a machine are known
and deliberate. Read by scripts/check-plugin-rollout.py (see its load_retired
and check_orphans docstrings).
This is the INVERSE of scripts/parked-plugins.json, and the two must not be
confused. A park says 'this plugin exists in crates/ and is deliberately NOT
armed yet'; its key MUST name a real crate. A retirement says 'this plugin no
longer exists in crates/ and the copy still sitting on this machine is known';
its key MUST NOT name a real crate. A stale retirement -- one naming a crate
that still exists -- is reported as a failure (rc=6), because it suppresses
nothing today while standing ready to silence a genuine red the day that crate
really is deleted.
Why the mechanism exists (backlog 0cd69e11): crates/taintguard was deleted from
the repo on 2026-08-24 (0521d013) by user ruling, and it stayed enabled in
~/.claude/settings.json and deployed in the plugin cache on the live machine
while check-plugin-rollout.py exited 0 the whole time. Every other dimension in
that script enumerates crates/ and walks outward, so none of them could see it.
The plugin section of CLAUDE.md says a CHANGE is inert until it is rolled out;
the inverse is that a REMOVAL is inert until it is propagated, and nothing
enforced the inverse.
Required per entry: reason, retired_at (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: revisit -- what
would make someone reconsider (a backlog id, a doc, a signal to watch for).
An entry moves that plugin's orphan findings -- and the cache's '<name>: cached
but no current version known from crates/' line -- out of the red lists into a
'RETIRED ON PURPOSE' report that prints every suppressed finding VERBATIM. It
is not a licence to leave the leftovers there: clearing a retirement means
removing the enabledPlugins key / uninstalling the plugin / deleting its cache
dir, and THEN deleting the entry -- in that order (the a6f165cd lesson, one
file over).
The file is empty on purpose. Measured 2026-09-10 on this machine: 41
@yukineko registry entries, 39 enabledPlugins keys and 41 cache dirs, and every
one of them maps to a crate under crates/ -- taintguard's removal was fully
propagated before this gate existed, so it needs no entry. Deleting this file
entirely is also valid and means the same thing.
